## Modules

- AshJsonApi
  - [AshJsonApi](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.md): Introspection functions for `AshJsonApi` domains.
  - [AshJsonApi.Domain](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Domain.md): The entrypoint for adding JSON:API behavior to an Ash domain

  - [AshJsonApi.Resource](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Resource.md): The entrypoint for adding JSON:API behavior to a resource"

  - [AshJsonApi.Router](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Router.md): Use this module to create a router for your AshJsonApi.

- Utilities
  - [AshJsonApi.OpenApi](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.OpenApi.md): Provides functions for generating schemas and operations for OpenApi definitions.
  - [AshJsonApi.Test](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Test.md): Utilities for testing AshJsonApi.

- Introspection
  - [AshJsonApi.Domain.Info](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Domain.Info.md): Introspection helpers for AshJsonApi.Domain
  - [AshJsonApi.Resource.Info](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Resource.Info.md): Introspection helpers for AshJsonApi.Resource
  - [AshJsonApi.Resource.Route](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Resource.Route.md): Represents a route for a resource

- Errors
  - [AshJsonApi.Error](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Error.md): Represents an AshJsonApi Error
  - [AshJsonApi.Error.ConflictingParams](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Error.ConflictingParams.md): Returned when path parameters and query parameters have conflicting names

  - [AshJsonApi.Error.InvalidBody](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Error.InvalidBody.md): Returned when the request body provided is invalid

  - [AshJsonApi.Error.InvalidField](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Error.InvalidField.md): Returned when a field is requested that does not exist or is invalid

  - [AshJsonApi.Error.InvalidFilter](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Error.InvalidFilter.md): Returned when a filter parameter is invalid or malformed

  - [AshJsonApi.Error.InvalidHeader](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Error.InvalidHeader.md): Returned when a header provided is invalid

  - [AshJsonApi.Error.InvalidIncludes](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Error.InvalidIncludes.md): Returned when the includes string provided in the query parameter `include`
is invalid.

  - [AshJsonApi.Error.InvalidPagination](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Error.InvalidPagination.md): Returned when one of the nested parameters provided in the query parameter `page` is invalid

  - [AshJsonApi.Error.InvalidPathParam](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Error.InvalidPathParam.md): Returned when a required path parameter is missing or invalid

  - [AshJsonApi.Error.InvalidQuery](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Error.InvalidQuery.md): Returned when the query provided is invalid

  - [AshJsonApi.Error.InvalidRelationshipInput](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Error.InvalidRelationshipInput.md): Returned when the request body provided is invalid

  - [AshJsonApi.Error.InvalidSort](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Error.InvalidSort.md): Returned when a sort parameter is invalid or malformed

  - [AshJsonApi.Error.InvalidType](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Error.InvalidType.md): Returned when a field is requested for a type that does not exist or is invalid

  - [AshJsonApi.Error.MissingSchema](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Error.MissingSchema.md): Returned when a required schema is not found for validation

  - [AshJsonApi.Error.MissingTypeOnCreate](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Error.MissingTypeOnCreate.md): Returned when a POST create request has a data object but no type member,
and the domain has require_type_on_create? enabled (JSON:API spec compliance).

  - [AshJsonApi.Error.NotFound](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Error.NotFound.md): Returned when a record was explicitly requested, but could not be found.

  - [AshJsonApi.Error.UnacceptableMediaType](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Error.UnacceptableMediaType.md): Returned when the client does not accept (via the `Accept` header) the JSON:API
media type: application/vnd.api+json

  - [AshJsonApi.Error.UnknownError](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Error.UnknownError.md): Returned when an unexpected error occurs that doesn't fit other categories

  - [AshJsonApi.Error.UnsupportedMediaType](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Error.UnsupportedMediaType.md): Returned when the client does not provide (via the `Content-Type` header) the
correct JSON:API media type: application/vnd.api+json

  - [AshJsonApi.ToJsonApiError](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.ToJsonApiError.md): A protocol for turning an Ash exception into an AshJsonApi.Error

- Internals
  - [AshJsonApi.Domain.BaseRoute](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Domain.BaseRoute.md): Introspection target for base routes in `AshJsonApi.Domain`
  - [AshJsonApi.Domain.Verifiers.VerifyActions](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Domain.Verifiers.VerifyActions.md): Verifies that all actions are valid for each route.
  - [AshJsonApi.Domain.Verifiers.VerifyHasType](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Domain.Verifiers.VerifyHasType.md): Verifies that a resource has a type if it has any routes that need it.
  - [AshJsonApi.Domain.Verifiers.VerifyQueryParams](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Domain.Verifiers.VerifyQueryParams.md): Verify query params are not reserved or shadowed by the route
  - [AshJsonApi.Domain.Verifiers.VerifyRelationships](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Domain.Verifiers.VerifyRelationships.md): Verifies that any routes that reference a relationship reference a public one
  - [AshJsonApi.Igniter](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Igniter.md): Codemods and utilities for working with AshJsonApi & Igniter
  - [AshJsonApi.Plug.Parser](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Plug.Parser.md): Extracts ash multipart request body.
  - [AshJsonApi.Resource.Verifiers.VerifyActions](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Resource.Verifiers.VerifyActions.md): Verifies that all actions are valid for each route.
  - [AshJsonApi.Resource.Verifiers.VerifyFieldReferences](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Resource.Verifiers.VerifyFieldReferences.md): Validates field names referenced in JSON:API DSL options
  - [AshJsonApi.Resource.Verifiers.VerifyHasType](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Resource.Verifiers.VerifyHasType.md): Verifies that a resource has a type if it has any routes that need it.
  - [AshJsonApi.Resource.Verifiers.VerifyIncludes](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Resource.Verifiers.VerifyIncludes.md): Verifies that all includes are valid public relationships
  - [AshJsonApi.Resource.Verifiers.VerifyQueryParams](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Resource.Verifiers.VerifyQueryParams.md): Verify query params are not reserved or shadowed by the route
  - [AshJsonApi.Resource.Verifiers.VerifyRelationships](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Resource.Verifiers.VerifyRelationships.md): Verifies that any routes that reference a relationship reference a public one
  - [AshJsonApi.Type](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/AshJsonApi.Type.md): The behaviour for customizing how a datatype is rendered and written in AshJsonApi.

## Mix Tasks

- Internals
  - [mix ash_json_api.install](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshJsonApi.Install.md): Installs AshJsonApi. Should be run with `mix igniter.install ash_json_api`
  - [mix ash_json_api.routes](https://ash-json-api.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.AshJsonApi.Routes.md): Prints all routes pertaining to AshJsonApi.Router for the default or a given router.
